newsitem.title: USA: Burlington sets line sale, considers more.
newsitem.headline: Burlington sets line sale, considers more.

text.p: Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp and RailAmerica Inc said Monday Burlington sold its Oroville line to RailAmerica for undisclosed terms.
They said financing was provided by National Bank of Canada.

The 131 mile rail line from Wenatchee to Oroville in north central Washington will be operated by Cascade and Columbia River Railroad Co, a RailAmerica subsidiary which has established its general offices at Omak, Wash.
Burlington also said it is considering the sale of about 4,000 miles of light-density lines over the coming years.
This is part of Burlington's ongoing asset evaluation program, the railroad said.
